Recent work

Geoff Nelder — Flying Crooked series

A working example rather than a mockup: what changed when the site actually had to sell books.

geoffnelder.com

Visit the live site →

The brief was simple: readers were landing on the site and leaving without buying. The fix wasn't a redesign for its own sake — it was closing the specific gaps that cost a sale: a reader in the wrong country hitting a dead link, a cover that didn't feel worth stopping for, a site that looked abandoned between book launches.

Dual marketplace buy buttonsUS and UK Amazon links side by side, so nobody bounces looking for their own store.
Animated cover presentationCovers float and respond on scroll instead of sitting as flat thumbnails.
Built to stay currentStructured so new titles and updates go in without a rebuild each time.
One system, not a patchworkSite, cover treatment, and launch material designed together from the start.

Case study numbers (traffic, conversion) to follow once a full launch cycle is measured — this describes what was actually built, not projected results.
